# TG Downloader

> Browser-based and Chrome extension assisted Telegram media downloader for accessible Telegram links, private-channel workflows, restricted posts, large files, and batch saves.

## Core Product

- [TG Downloader Home](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/): Main Telegram video download entry with link parsing, private-channel guidance, troubleshooting, and installation path for Telegram Web workflows.
- [Pricing](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/pricing/): Buy one-time Credits or upgrade to Unlimited monthly plugin access.
- [About TG Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/about/): Product identity, website and extension responsibilities, privacy principles, and access boundaries.
- [Contact TG Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/contact/): Public support channel for account, download, extension, billing, and privacy questions.
- [Full content index](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/llms-full.txt): Complete AI-readable page index including platform downloaders, language entrances, technical indexes, plans, and updates.

## Download Tools

- [TikTok Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/tiktok-downloader/): Parse public TikTok links and download videos without watermark when the source is supported.
- [X Twitter Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/x-downloader/): Parse public X or Twitter video status links and download videos or GIF media.
- [Vimeo Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/vimeo-downloader/): Parse public Vimeo video links and download available video sources.
- [Instagram Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/instagram-downloader/): Parse public Instagram posts for photos, Reels, and carousel media.
- [Threads Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/threads-downloader/): Parse public Threads posts for videos and photos.

## Updates

- [Changelog](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/changelog/): Release notes for Telegram download workflow changes, larger file support, and product updates.
- [Sitemap](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap index for canonical pages and per-language sitemap files.

## Key Facts

- Platform type: Browser website plus Chrome extension assisted Telegram Web workflow.
- Default language: English.
- Language coverage: 14 website locales.
- Supported website parser pages: Telegram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Vimeo, Instagram, and Threads.
- Telegram extension workflow: Designed for Telegram Web media that is visible to the user, including private-channel and restricted-save situations where the user already has access.
- Safety boundary: TG Downloader should not ask for Telegram passwords, verification codes, API credentials, or session files.
